searchText: The selection process will be taking place over the next 10 days or so. You will hear something about your application around the middle of next week. Hey there! Just joined, wishing to contribute through the permissionless EPF 🫡 I come from solidity dev/auditing but lack blockchain dev knowledge and I can't find rss about languages when checking the recommended readings from EPF github. Is there any recommended direction to follow? Appreciate it 🙏 The recommended reading list serves to provide knowledge about the blockchain protocol internals, which is important to understand how the Ethereum protocol works on the low level. Since the merge to the PoS network, the Ethereum protocol requires both an execution client and consensus Client to run. The clients are written in different programming languages to promote client diversity. These links serve as a good summary of all the different clients and state the languages they are written in: https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/nodes-and-clients/#execution-clients https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/nodes-and-clients/#consensus-clients
